title: Implement the once-per-tick shared BVH resource service
requires: A physical supported GPU, shared Slang build toolchain and public-API test harness
scope: Implement the backend-neutral spatial resource lifecycle and shared kernel service with one published dynamic hierarchy epoch per tick. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md; preserve legacy-profile evidence and do not expand advertised interaction modes.
acceptance: Implement admission, conservative bounds, active-leaf generation, build/refit, candidate queries and snapshot lifetime per F8-05; immutable mesh-local trees remain cached.
Enforce at most one dynamic update per tick across domains/populations/edges; reject stale epoch/generation use and test topology edits, compaction, spawn/removal and reset.
Verify full-tick candidate completeness against independent small-scene brute force, including rotation and allowed solve corrections; enforce explicit bounded overflow/out-of-envelope behavior.
Keep counts/scratch GPU resident with bounded memory and no new routine CPU phase waits; expose accurate update/build/refit counts for later telemetry.
